question: Find the value of [ (27 times 3) times left{ 3 div 3 times ((19 - 15))/(4) right} ]
solution:
Given:

Expression: [ (27 times 3) times left{ 3 div 3 times ((19 - 15))/(4) right} ]

Calculation:

[ (27 times 3) times left{ 3 div 3 times ((19 - 15))/(4) right} ]

⇒ [ (27 times 3) times left{ 3 div 3 times (4)/(4) right} ]

⇒ [ (27 times 3) times left{ 1 times (4)/(4) right} ]

⇒ [ (27 times 3) times left{ 1 times 1 right} ]

⇒ [ (27 times 3) times 1 ]

⇒ [ 81 times 1 ]

⇒ 81

∴ The value of the expression is 81.
